					<h1 class="page-title u-visually-hidden">The Fresh Food Co. at West Campus</h1>
					<p style="text-align: center;">Students use the term &#8220;West is Best&#8221; and with more than 20 different food stations surrounded by views of Nickerson Field, they may be on to something. Featuring the famous West Burger alongside stations that serve Halal food items, a dedicated vegan station, our new True Balance station, plus a gluten free pantry loaded with snacks and meals ready to eat, you quickly learn why &#8220;West is Best&#8221;!</p>


<h3 class="location-single-meta-title">Features:</h3>

Students, faculty, staff and guests with food allergies and celiac disease should also be advised that meals are prepared in a commercial kitchen where cross-contact with allergens is possible; therefore, we cannot guarantee that any item is completely free of allergens.
